worked_solution:
First, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $z,$ treating $x$ and $y$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-y}^{0}{\int }_{0}^{x}2{e}^{z+1}\,dz\,dx\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-y}^{0}[{\int }_{0}^{x}2{e}^{z+1}\,dz]dx\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-y}^{0}2[{e}^{z+1}]_{z=0}^{z=x}\,dx\,dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-y}^{0}2({e}^{x+1}-e)\,dx\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral by integrating with respect to $x,$ treating $y$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{-y}^{0}2({e}^{x+1}-e)\,dx\,dy & ={\int }_{0}^{1}[2{\int }_{-y}^{0}{e}^{x+1}-e\,dx]dy \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{1}2[{e}^{x+1}-ex]_{x=-y}^{x=0}\,dy \\  & =2{\int }_{0}^{1}{e}^{0+1}-e(0)-({e}^{-y+1}-e(-y))dy \\  & =2{\int }_{0}^{1}e-{e}^{1-y}-ey\,dy\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we integrate with respect to $y:$

$$
\begin{aligned}2{\int }_{0}^{1}e-{e}^{1-y}-ey\,dy & =2{[ey+{e}^{1-y}-\frac{e}{2}{y}^{2}]}_{y=0}^{y=1} \\  & =2(e(1-0)+{e}^{1-1}-{e}^{1-0}-\frac{e}{2}({1}^{2}-{0}^{2})) \\  & =2(e+1-e-\frac{e}{2}) \\  & =2-e\end{aligned}
$$
